name: Chris
label: Frustrated by renewal pop-ups after cancelling
who: I'm a Spotify user on iOS or Android who had premium and then cancelled, but the app keeps showing a renewal prompt. I mostly use the app to play and skip songs, and I expect it to work normally after updates.
value_for_money: Implies that once a premium member cancels, they expect the app to work without renewal prompts; several posters say they cancelled over the pop-up. Price itself is not discussed.
loyalty: Stays for basic playback; would leave if the renewal pop-up keeps appearing after cancelling, as several posters say they did.
pain_points: Renewal pop-up appears every time the app opens
Clearing cache and reinstalling do not fix it
Bugs appear right after app updates
likes: Quick fixes like reinstalling the app
tone: Terse and exasperated, describing symptoms step by step and asking the group for fixes.
